name: Shenyang Municipal People's Government (Shenyang SASAC)
via: city-level government of Shenyang, Liaoning, China; its State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission (Shenyang SASAC) exercises the state's ownership rights in the city's state-owned enterprises
note: Shenyang SASAC ('沈阳市国资委') publishes the state-owned enterprises it supervises on gzw.shenyang.gov.cn, including Shenyang Shengjing Assets Management Group Co., Ltd.
